text:
The output sits at about 0.235 V (VDD − Vds(M7) = 1.8 − 1.565), so the amplifier is railed low in open loop rather than biased near 0.9 V. The first-stage mirror is the likely cause. M3 (diode-connected load for M1) carries 6.16 µA, while M4 (load for M2) is drawn with m=3 and carries 19.2 µA, a 3:1 ratio. The other mirror devices are all m=1, so M4 is the only anomalous multiplier. This forces M2 to draw about 3× the current of M1, which leaves n about 55 mV below vcm and pushes the second-stage node oa_b high. That turns M7 nearly off, so the output is pulled to ground through M8. M4 also appears in the f_unity sensitivity list.

The input pair's DC balance is lost, node oa_b is driven high, M7 turns nearly off, and vout collapses to about 0.235 V (offset -0.66 V). This also shifts the first-stage gain and f_unity."}
